diagnosis: The checks C1 and C3 passed in rollouts 2 and 3 because the decision-maker used the fact 'S1', 'S2', and 'S3' to justify the approval of temporary privileges for electrophysiology procedures on May 14. These facts were derived from the cardiology review, which changed the decision from an unsupported approval to approval limited to intracardiac electrophysiology study and catheter ablation on May 14 (PF1). Since the decision-maker did not have access to PF1, the checks C1 and C3 passed due to the default behavior of approving electrophysiology procedures based on the available information.
